metadata.title: Rigidity of volume-minimizing free boundary hypersurfaces in high dimensional Riemannian manifolds
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we establish a volume estimate and an associated rigidity result for volume-minimizing free boundary hypersurfaces in an $(n+1)$-dimensional Riemannian manifold $M$. First, we derive a volume estimate for stable minimal free boundary hypersurfaces in terms of the scalar curvature of $M$ and the second fundamental form of the boundary $\partial M$. We then prove rigidity results of $M$ in the corresponding equality cases.

analysis.progressType: 高维自由边界极小超曲面的体积刚性
analysis.workSummary: 用环境标量曲率与边界第二基本形式控制稳定自由边界极小超曲面的体积，再证明体积极小情形等号对应的环境刚性。
analysis.breakthrough: 把体积界与邻域几何的刚性联系。
analysis.limitations: 稳定极小与体积极小条件在不同结论中出现，不能相互替代；摘要未列出所有维数和符号条件。
